claim: INIT is the single seed-everything routine (mushrooms, centipede, spider, ant) the game reuses at power-on and at game start
The 1-player START button is read as START1; an unpressed button (carry set after LSR) skips starting the game
START1 gate: BCS branches away IF 1 PLAYER GAME NOT STARTED — i.e. the game begins only when the button reads active
Starting a game seeds LIVES from NLIVES minus one (the on-screen gun is the extra life not counted in LIVES)

source.verbatim: STX LIVES		;NUMBER OF LIVES-1 (WE ARE PLAYING WITH ONE)

claim: Starting a game advances MODE into play (INC MODE — the attract->playing transition)
In attract, the life-exhaustion check is skipped (BPL to the life test only when not in attract)

source.verbatim: BPL 55$			;IF IN ATTRACT DO NOT CHECK LIVES

claim: Game-over test reads the two-byte LIVES; a non-zero total means the game is not over
The high byte of the game-over LIVES test (LIVES+1, the 2-player slot) is OR-ed in before the not-over branch
Both LIVES bytes zero falls through to game over; a non-zero total branches to keep playing (IF GAME NOT OVER)
Game over drops MODE back to attract (DEC MODE, MODE=-1 FOR ATTRACT)
ATTRT is real self-playing gameplay run in attract mode, not a static screen
The demo gun moves only every other 128-frame block: it skips the frame when FRAME bit 7 is set (AND I,80 / BNE 70$ 'DON'T MOVE THIS FRAME')
The demo gun reverses to move RIGHT when PLAYH drops below 0x1C (CMP I,1C / BCC reverse)
The demo gun reverses to move LEFT when PLAYH reaches 0xE4 (CMP I,0E4 / BCS reverse)
The demo gun's horizontal sweep direction is stored in PLAYDH and moved by MHOR
The demo gun also sweeps vertically, reversing UP when PLAYV reaches 0x30 (CMP I,30 / BCS reverse)
The demo gun reverses DOWN when PLAYV drops below 9 (CMP I,9 / BCC reverse)
The demo gun's vertical sweep direction is stored in PLAYDV and moved by MVER
The demo gun fires by repositioning/releasing the shot via RSHOT1 each attract frame
Attract draws the '1980 ATARI' copyright message (CPYRHT via MESSAG)
Attract draws the 'BONUS LIFE EVERY XXXX' panel showing the DIP-selected bonus increment (BONUS routine)

source.verbatim: .SBTTL	BONUS - DISPLAY "BONUS LIFE EVERY XXXX" MESSAGE

claim: The bonus increment table BONUSV holds *100-per-bonus-life words (100->10000 the factory default at OPTNS D4-D5=00)
